description: Source file implementing the LoggingPreferences plugin for WPEFramework, managing keystroke mask settings via IARM bus calls, including initialization, deinitialization, and event notification.

classes.name: LoggingPreferences
classes.description: A plugin class managing logging preferences, particularly keystroke masking, with methods for initialization, setting, and event notification.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up IARM communication.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: isKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether keystroke masking is enabled.

methods.name: setKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Sets the keystroke masking enabled or disabled.

methods.name: onKeystrokeMaskEnabledChange
methods.description: Notifies other components of a change in keystroke masking status.
